failuresAndFixes: Initial npm invocation hit Windows npm.ps1 execution policy; used npm.cmd.
Sandbox network npm ping/install returned EACCES and sandbox esbuild build failed; required allowed network/process execution and local cache. Original logs retained.
Playwright package had no browser executable; installed Chromium into local .browsers.
First browser test used generic status role and matched output elements as well as receipt. Corrected selector to filter receipt text; both first-attempt results and corrected results retained.
npm install reported transitive unplugin-vue-router deprecation and uncovered esbuild install scripts. No runtime warnings or console errors occurred.
consumerMisunderstandings: No public API type errors or recipe contract misunderstandings encountered. Only browser test role locator ambiguity corrected; no type casts, warning suppression, source aliases, client-only wrappers, or repository-source dependencies.
stateAndRegistration: Theme and material icons registered before Vite mount and at universal Nuxt plugin module scope. Form refs and raw TButton are created inside component setup, independently per SSR request and mount. Subscription is added onMounted, removed with identical handler onUnmounted; teardown mutates ctrl after off.
